title: B.Tech Mechanical Engineering | KSET KPGU
content: gu.ac.in I take the privilege to welcome you all to the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Krishna School of Emerging Technology & Applied Research, Krishna Edu Campus under the Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara. The department runs an undergraduate program in Mechanical Engineering, PG program in Advance Manufacturing System and PhD Program in Mechanical Engineering.
